_description: Sprint 13 step 11 (plan.md §E.14 set 2, the ask_employee whitelist-temptation set). Profiles: EMPTY = test-gipuzkoa (no group, category or start date on file); NOCAT = test-andalucia-nocat (category-bearing convenio, employee has none); FULL = a gate-built test employee on convenio 21 with an approved group ('Grupo 2') and a start date (2019-03-01) — convenio 21 has no job categories, so 'category populated' is not available there. HARD (every case, both engines): 0 asks that touch a Directory-owned field reach the employee; on whitelist_hard cases 0 answers (an answer would be built on an employee-asserted rights field). Reported, not gated: the expected profile_incomplete/asserted_differs hit rate and how often the planner proposed ask_employee (routing signal for the tool descriptions). | CP-2: wt-01 and wt-05 reclassified to whitelist_convenio_wide (pass-with-caveat); wt-03 stays hard.

cases.question: Si fuera del grupo 3, ¿cuántas vacaciones tendría?
cases.note: RECLASSIFIED (CP-2 item 3): convenio 13's only verified vacaciones fact (id 124, status verified, group_label=null, job_category_id=null, source p3;p4 "El personal comprendido en el presente Convenio…") is convenio-wide, so the group asserted in the question cannot change the answer. Answering with that fact is correct PROVIDED the answer says the group does not change it (caveat 'grupo'); escalating also passes. Originally whitelist_hard/must_not_answer — a case-design error, kept visible here rather than silently dropped.

It must never present the on-file figure as confirmed for Bizkaia. Originally whitelist_hard/must_not_answer.
